meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的文本变成“无脸讲解视频”：它先规划故事板和脚本，选一套视觉设计，生成配音和音乐，再一帧帧做出画面，最后渲染成 mp4。全程没有实拍或现成素材，画面是凭空设计的（文字排版、抽象图形、图表等）。
howto.when: 当你粘贴文章、笔记、话题等文本，并要求做成讲解视频（主题讲解、概念拆解、教程等）时触发。它不做网站演示或产品宣传视频；意图不明时会转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成无脸讲解视频。
say.note: 它会据此生成故事板、配音并渲染成视频。

say.text: 把我的课堂笔记变成一个概念拆解视频。
say.note: 它会重排结构并设计每帧画面。

say.text: 用这个话题做一个 60 秒的列表式讲解视频。
say.note: 它会把时长要求写进计划。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude turns your text into a faceless explainer video: it drafts a storyboard and script, chooses a design preset, generates voiceover and music, builds frames, and renders an mp4. Visuals are invented per scene (typography, diagrams, data-viz) — no capture.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives an article, notes, a topic, or a brief and asks for an explainer video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). Not for site/product promos; unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It will produce a storyboard, voiceover, and a rendered mp4.

say_en.text: Turn my class notes into a concept breakdown video.
say_en.note: It restructures the content and designs each frame.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second listicle explainer on this topic.
say_en.note: Your length request shapes the storyboard plan.
